title: Project: Pentaho MCP Server
description: Project, built over several sessions and not assessed: write a Python MCP server in front of Carte so AI assistants can list, run and monitor Pentaho Data Integration transformations and jobs, with an allow-listed folder, a read-only mode and an audit log. Then drive it from a check script, from Pentaho Data Integration (MCP Client and AI Chat's Tools tab) and from a desktop AI assistant.
